data.name: Lakshraj
data.gender_notes: Lakshraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lakshraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Laksh' which means 'goal' or 'objective'. The name signifies the attainment of wealth, prosperity, and fortune. In Hindu mythology, the god Lakshmi is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name Lakshraj carries the meaning “Fortune, Wealth, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lakshraj usually hope their child will grow to embody fortune, wealth, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the attainment of spiritual wealth and prosperity in life.
data.etymology: Lakshraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fortune, Wealth, Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lakshraj total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Lakshraj is rooted in ancient Hindu tradition and carries a strong cultural significance. It connotes the pursuit of material success, a common value in many Indian societies. The name is also reminiscent of the Hindu gods Vishnu and Lakshmi, who are associated with the preservation and bestowal of wealth and prosperity, respectively.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Lakshraj embodies the idea of seeking material wealth as a means to attain spiritual growth and enlightenment. It serves as a constant reminder that material prospects can provide the means to lead a comfortable and secure life, which in turn enables one to focus on spiritual pursuits and inner growth. This name thus encourages the idea of balancing material success with spiritual advancement, highlighting the interconnectedness of both aspects of existence in the Hindu philosophy.

vedic_reference.root_origin: Sanskrit, derived from the name of the goddess Lakshmi
vedic_reference.note: Lakshraj is a name derived from the name of the goddess Lakshmi, meaning 'Lakshmi's king' or 'Lakshmi's ruler'.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Lakshraj was a prominent Jain businessman and scholar from Gujarat, India in the 16th century. The name Lakshraj carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: During this time, the Jain religion saw a resurgence in Gujarat with the patronage of wealthy merchants and scholars. Lakshraj was one such individual who contributed significantly to Jain studies through his scholarship and business activities.

historical_references.reference: Another reference to Lakshraj is found in the Jain text 'Prabandhachintamani'. In this text, Lakshraj is mentioned as a ruler of Marwar in the 12th century.
historical_references.context: During this time, Marwar was an important center of Jainism and Lakshraj, as a ruler, played a significant role in supporting and promoting Jainism in the region.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Lakshraj has modern context in three different domains. In the business world, it is seen on LinkedIn profiles of professionals with this name. In the technology sector, it is used as a GitHub username for developers. In the spiritual context, it is used as a name in Hindu communities, with a focus on the spiritual meaning of the name, which is 'God's grace'. The name Lakshraj is also associated with the concept of 'Lakshmi', the Hindu goddess of wealth and prosperity, and is sometimes used as a variation of this name.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Amit Lakshraj in Chennai, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Lakshraj, which means "Fortune, Wealth, Prosperity". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
